tasks.name: 与豺狼人开战
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将10份木爪豺狼人的鬃毛交给莫沙彻营地的哈杜肯·迅蹄。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 10 Woodpaw Gnoll Manes to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

tasks.name: 突然袭击
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在1个小时内杀死5个木爪突击队员，并向哈杜肯·迅蹄汇报。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 5 Woodpaw Alphas and return to Hadoken Swiftstrider within one hour.

tasks.name: 调查木爪岭
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在莫沙彻营地以南的豺狼人营地中寻找豺狼人的战斗计划。
tasks.objective_text_en: Find the gnoll battle plans somewhere in the gnoll camps to the south of Camp Mojache.

tasks.name: 作战计划
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把木爪豺狼人的作战计划交给莫沙彻营地的哈杜肯·迅蹄。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Woodpaw Battle Plans to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

tasks.name: 新斗篷的光辉
tasks.objective_text_zh: 给莫沙彻营地的克鲁伊格·碎颅带去10个闪光的小精灵翅膀。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 10 Iridescent Sprite Darter Wings to Krueg Skullsplitter in Camp Mojache.

tasks.name: 可怕的发现
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集20支恐怖图腾之角，把它们交给莫沙彻营地的克鲁伊格·碎颅。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 20 Grimtotem Horns to Krueg Skullsplitter in Camp Mojache.

tasks.name: 菲拉斯的食人魔
tasks.objective_text_zh: 莫沙彻营地的洛卡-奥赫要你杀掉10个戈杜尼食人魔、10个戈杜尼食人魔法师和5个戈杜尼蛮兵。
tasks.objective_text_en: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Ogres, 10 Gordunni Ogre-Magi, and 5 Gordunni Brutes.

tasks.name: 戈杜尼卷轴
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将戈杜尼卷轴交给莫沙彻营地的洛克·奥汉。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Gordunni Scroll to Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache.

tasks.name: 戈杜尼钴矿石
tasks.objective_text_zh: 莫沙彻营地的奥尔文·吉兹米克需要12块戈杜尼钴矿石的样本。
tasks.objective_text_en: Orwin Gizzmick in Camp Mojache wants 12 samples of Gordunni Cobalt.

blocks.block: 赛车场与塔纳利斯第一轮

tasks.name: 地精的谣言
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把地精的谣言带给千针石林中闪光平原的克拉维尔·浓须。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Goblin Rumors to Kravel Koalbeard on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles.

tasks.name: 地精赞助商
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把燃料调节器的蓝图带给闪光平原的普兹克。
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver the Fuel Regulator Blueprints to Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats.

tasks.name: 第十八个驾驶员
tasks.objective_text_zh: 和千针石林闪光平原的拉泽瑞克谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Razzeric on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles.

tasks.name: 跟上节奏
tasks.objective_text_zh: 让扎米克掩护你，然后为千针石林闪光平原的普兹克偷到瑞兹尔的计划。
tasks.objective_text_en: Have Zamek create a diversion, then steal Rizzle's plans for Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles.

tasks.name: 瑞兹尔的图表
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把精铁矿石样本交给千针石林闪光平原上的普兹克。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Sample of Indurium Ore to Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles.

tasks.name: 废土的公正
tasks.objective_text_zh: 去加基森的东面杀掉10个废土窃贼和10个废土强盗，然后向总工程师比格维兹复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Take down 10 Wastewander Bandits and Thieves east of Gadgetzan, then report back to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle.

start_entities.name: 首席工程师沙克斯·比格维兹

finish_entities.name: 首席工程师沙克斯·比格维兹

tasks.name: 废土的公正
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死10个废土暗法师、8个废土游荡者和6个废土刺客，然后向加基森的总工程师比格维兹报告。
tasks.objective_text_en: Take down 10 Wastewander Shadow Mages, 8 Wastewander Rogues, and 6 Wastewander Assassins for Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

start_entities.name: 首席工程师沙克斯·比格维兹

finish_entities.name: 首席工程师沙克斯·比格维兹

tasks.name: 通缉：卡利夫·斯科比斯汀
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将卡利夫·斯科比斯汀的徽记交给加基森的首席工程师沙克斯·比格维兹。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the head of Caliph Scorpidsting to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

finish_entities.name: 首席工程师沙克斯·比格维兹

tasks.name: 通缉：安德雷·费尔比德
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将安德雷的徽记交给热砂港的安全主管吉罗姆·比格维兹。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Andre's Head to Security Chief Bilgewhizzle in Steamwheedle Port.

finish_entities.name: 安全主管吉罗姆·比格维兹

tasks.name: 南海复仇
tasks.objective_text_zh: 塔纳利斯热砂港的安全主管吉罗姆·比格维兹要你去干掉10个南海海盗、10个南海劫掠者、10个南海码头工人和10个南海流氓。
tasks.objective_text_en: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris wants you to kill 10 Southsea Pirates, 10 Southsea Freebooters, 10 Southsea Dock Workers and 10 Southsea Swashbucklers.

start_entities.name: 安全主管吉罗姆·比格维兹

finish_entities.name: 安全主管吉罗姆·比格维兹

tasks.name: 加基森水业公司
tasks.objective_text_zh: 用未使用的寻水器在流沙岗哨旁边的池中采集水样。一旦你收集到水样，就尽快将其交给加基森的高级勘探员菲兹杜瑟。
tasks.objective_text_en: Use the untapped dowsing widget near the pool of water by Sandsorrow Watch. Once you have collected the sample, return the tapped dowsing widget to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.

tasks.name: 拉泽瑞克的调整
tasks.objective_text_zh: 为闪光平原的拉泽瑞克取回爆盐增压器。
tasks.objective_text_en: Retrieve the Seaforium Booster for Razzeric in the Shimmering Flats.

tasks.name: 收集水袋
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集5只废土水袋，把它们交给加基森的鲁格伦克。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 5 Wastewander Water Pouches to Spigot Operator Luglunket in Gadgetzan.

tasks.name: 海盗的帽子！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 塔纳利斯热砂港的傲慢的店主要你去帮他收集20顶南海海盗帽。
tasks.objective_text_en: Haughty Modiste wants you to collect 20 Southsea Pirate Hats and return them to her at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

tasks.name: 腐化之巢
tasks.objective_text_zh: 从腐化之巢找5个森提帕尔昆虫肢体，把它们交给加基森的炼金师匹斯特苏格。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring five Centipaar insect parts from the Noxious Lair to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

tasks.name: 谢申克的救赎
tasks.objective_text_zh: 寻找初级勘探员谢申克的下落，把他或者他的勘探设备交给加基森的高级勘探员菲兹杜瑟。
tasks.objective_text_en: Discover the fate of Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, and bring either him or his surveying equipment to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.

tasks.name: 斯杜雷的债务
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与热砂港的斯杜雷谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Stoley in Steamwheedle Port.

tasks.name: 斯杜雷的货物
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将斯杜雷的货物交给热砂港的斯杜雷。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Stoley's Shipment to Stoley in Steamwheedle Port.

tasks.name: 船运时刻表
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把船运时刻表交给热砂港的某个官员。
tasks.objective_text_en: Report the Ship Schedules to an authority in Steamwheedle Port.

finish_entities.name: 安全主管吉罗姆·比格维兹

blocks.block: 菲拉斯高等级回访与灵魂链

tasks.name: 菲拉斯的食人魔
tasks.objective_text_zh: 莫沙彻营地的洛卡·奥赫要你去杀掉十个戈杜尼萨满祭司、10个戈杜尼术士和5个戈杜尼虐待者。
tasks.objective_text_en: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Shaman, 10 Gordunni Warlocks, and 5 Gordunni Maulers.

tasks.name: 黑暗之心
tasks.objective_text_zh: 莫沙彻营地的塔罗·刺蹄要你给他拿去艾丹娜·邪爪的黑心。
tasks.objective_text_en: Talo Thornhoof in Camp Mojache wants Edana Hatetalon's Dark Heart.

tasks.name: 对鹰身人的复仇
tasks.objective_text_zh: 塔罗·刺蹄让你杀掉4个北泉鹰身人、4个北泉游荡者、4个北泉唤风者和4个北泉杀戮者。
tasks.objective_text_en: Talo Thornhoof wants you to kill 4 Northspring Harpies, 4 Northspring Roguefeathers, 4 Northspring Windcallers, and 4 Northspring Slayers.

tasks.name: 尖啸者的灵魂
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在菲拉斯捕获3个尖啸者的灵魂，然后回到热砂港的叶基亚那里去。
tasks.objective_text_en: Capture the spirits of 3 screechers in Feralas, then return to Yeh'kinya in Steamwheedle Port.

tasks.name: 祖卡什的入侵
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把20块祖卡什虫壳交给菲拉斯莫沙彻营地的哈杜肯·迅蹄。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

tasks.name: 毒刺鞭笞者
tasks.objective_text_zh: 击败痛苦深渊中的毒刺鞭笞者，把它的腺体交给菲拉斯莫沙彻营地的哈杜肯·迅蹄。
tasks.objective_text_en: Defeat Stinglasher in the Writhing Deep, bringing its glands back to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

tasks.name: 祖卡什报告
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把莫沙彻营地祖卡什报告交给奥格瑞玛暗巷区的基尔兹宾·鼓眼。
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver the Camp Mojache Zukk'ash Report to Zilzibin Drumlore. He resides in the Drag of Orgrimmar.

tasks.name: 可怕的发现
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将一箱恐怖图腾之角交给奥格瑞玛的贝尔戈洛姆·石槌。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Crate of Grimtotem Horns to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.

tasks.name: 奇怪的要求
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将皱缩的徽记交给拉瑞斯小亭的夏拉什·火刃。
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Shrunken Head to Xerash Fireblade at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas.

tasks.name: 向巫医尤克里回复
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将尼尔鲁的草药包送给菲拉斯的巫医尤克里。
tasks.objective_text_en: Deliver Xerash's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

tasks.name: 测试容器
tasks.objective_text_zh: 去杀掉10头铁鬃熊或是长牙奔跑者，然后使用灵魂精华容器捕获它们的灵魂。 /  / 将灵魂精华容器和10个野兽灵魂精华交给菲拉斯的巫医尤克里。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 10 Ironfur Bears or Longtooth Runners, and use the Beast Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen beasts.

tasks.name: 角鹰兽灵魂精华
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉10只任意种类的乱羽角鹰兽，然后用灵魂精华容器捕获它们的灵魂。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 10 Frayfeather Hippogryphs of any type, then use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture them.

tasks.name: 精灵龙灵魂精华
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉8只精龙或小精龙，然后用灵魂精华容器捕获它们的灵魂。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 8 Sprite Darters or Sprite Dragons. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Faerie Dragons.

tasks.name: 树人灵魂精华
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉3个森林漫游者，然后用灵魂精华容器捕获它们的灵魂。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 3 Wandering Forest Walkers. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Treants.

tasks.name: 山岭巨人灵魂精华
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉7个大地行者或者峭壁巨人，然后用灵魂精华容器捕获它们的灵魂。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 7 Land Walkers or Cliff Giants. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Mountain Giants.

tasks.name: 砂槌食人魔
tasks.objective_text_zh: 加基森的安迪·利恩想要你攻入砂槌营地，杀死10个砂槌蛮兵、10个砂槌执行者，以及掠夺者格玛洛克。
tasks.objective_text_en: Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.

tasks.name: 灌木谷
tasks.objective_text_zh: 加基森的特兰雷克要你杀掉8只长瘤的灌木兽和8只灌木塑根者。
tasks.objective_text_en: Tran'rek in Gadgetzan wants you to kill 8 Gnarled Thistleshrubs and 8 Thistleshrub Rootshapers.

tasks.name: 口渴的地精
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到1个饱满的露水腺，把它交给加基森的马林·诺格弗格。
tasks.objective_text_en: Collect a Laden Dew Gland and bring it to Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan.

tasks.name: 好味道
tasks.objective_text_zh: 马林·诺格弗格让你与加基森的斯普琳科谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Marin Noggenfogger wants you to speak with Sprinkle in Gadgetzan.

blocks.block: 辛特兰恶齿村与辛萨罗

tasks.name: 钳嘴龟！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的钓鱼者卡图姆要你去杀掉10只海水钳嘴龟。完成任务之后回到他那里去复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 10 Saltwater Snapjaw turtles. Return to him when you have completed this task.

tasks.name: 加莫里塔！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的钓鱼者卡图姆要你去杀掉加莫里塔，并从它的尸体上找到卡图姆的超级鱼饵。 /  / 卡图姆说加莫里塔和其它海龟都在海岸附近活动。
tasks.objective_text_en: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill Gammerita and retrieve Katoom's Best Lure from her corpse.

tasks.name: 银鬃捕猎者
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的猎户马克霍尔要求你去杀掉5头银鬃捕猎者和5头银鬃嗥狼。完成任务之后就回到他那里复命。 /  / 马克霍尔说过那些狼都躲在辛特兰的野外。
tasks.objective_text_en: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 5 Silvermane Stalkers and 5 Silvermane Howlers. Return to him once the task is complete.

tasks.name: 野蛮的枭兽
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的猎户马克霍尔要求你去杀掉10头野蛮的枭兽。完成任务之后就回到他那里复命。 /  / 马克霍尔说过那些野蛮的枭兽都躲在辛特兰的野外。
tasks.objective_text_en: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 10 Savage Owlbeasts. Return to him once the task is complete.

tasks.name: 死者的复仇
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的猎户马克霍尔要求你杀掉一头翱翔的锋喙狮鹫，并将它的狮鹫长羽拿回去交给他。 /  / 马克霍尔说过那些翱翔的锋喙狮鹫就躲在辛特兰的野外。
tasks.objective_text_en: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete.

tasks.name: 拉尔德的午餐
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的拉尔德要求你去找到拉尔德的午餐。完成任务之后就回到他那里去。 /  / 拉尔德说他把午餐留在了北面的岛上。当心邪枝巨魔。
tasks.objective_text_en: Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete.

tasks.name: 给蛮锤部族的警告
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的奥索·莫吉克要你去杀掉8个高原前锋、5个高原斥候和2个高原神射手。任务完成之后回到他那里去复命。 /  / 你可以在辛特兰西北部的奎尔丹尼小屋找到那些高原精灵。
tasks.objective_text_en: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to slaughter 8 Highvale Scouts, 5 Highvale Outrunners, 5 Highvale Rangers and 2 Highvale Marksman. Return to him when this task is complete.

tasks.name: 又一个给蛮锤部族的警告
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的奥索·莫吉克要你从辛特兰的狮鹫身上收集1根细长的狮鹫羽毛。任务完成之后回到他那里去复命。 /  / 在辛特兰各处都有狮鹫出没。
tasks.objective_text_en: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to bring him 1 Long Elegant Feather from the gryphons that inhabit the Hinterlands. Return to him once this task is complete.

tasks.name: 野蛮的亲戚
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的秘法师雅尔金要你去杀掉6个邪枝割颅者和2个邪枝占卜者。任务完成之后回到他那里去复命。 /  / 秘法师雅尔金说过，你可以在辛特兰东北部的沙尔瓦萨和亚戈瓦萨神庙附近找到那些巨魔。
tasks.objective_text_en: Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 6 Vilebranch Scalpers and 2 Vilebranch Soothsayers. Return to her when this task is complete.

tasks.name: 被绑架的断齿长者！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的断齿族长要求你到辛萨罗去拯救她的爱人，断齿长者。 /  / 你听说他被关在辛萨罗顶部，辛萨罗位于辛特兰的南部地区，那里是邪枝巨魔的主城。
tasks.objective_text_en: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to rescue her mate, Elder Torntusk, from Jintha'alor.

tasks.name: 找回钥匙！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛萨罗的断齿长者要求你杀掉守护者希坦亚，并用她身上的镣铐钥匙打开他的镣铐。当你找到钥匙之后就回到他那里去。
tasks.objective_text_en: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to kill Hitah'ya the Keeper to get the Shackle Key to his bindings. Return to Elder Torntusk when you have recovered the key.

tasks.name: 向断齿族长复命
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛萨罗的断齿长者要求你将他已经被营救的消息带给恶齿村的断齿族长。
tasks.objective_text_en: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village with news of his rescue.

tasks.name: 分离的痛苦
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的猎户马克霍尔要你去找回他的双胞胎兄弟的尸体。找到它，然后把猎户莫克霍尔的徽记和猎户莫克霍尔的骨头交给猎户马克霍尔。 /  / 马克霍尔说过，他兄弟的尸体被软泥怪和邪枝巨魔的狼群分食。他还提到在辛萨罗有个大坑，里面全都是软泥怪，那里还有个狼穴。这两个地方都在靠近辛萨罗神庙顶部的区域。
tasks.objective_text_en: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover his twin brother's remains. Find and return Huntsman Malkhor's Skull and Huntsman Malkhor's Bones to Huntsman Markhor.

tasks.name: 黑暗之瓶
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的断齿族长要你在辛萨罗找到5瓶腐化之血。任务完成之后就回到断齿族长那里。
tasks.objective_text_en: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover 5 Vessels of Tainted Blood from Jintha'alor. Return to Primal Torntusk when this task is complete.

tasks.name: 通缉：邪恶祭司海克斯和她的爪牙
tasks.name_en: Wanted: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions
tasks.objective_text_zh: 你必须杀掉邪恶祭司海克斯和5名邪枝精英守卫。任务完成之后回到辛特兰的恶齿村，向断齿族长报告。 /  / 你可以在辛特兰的邪枝巨魔城市辛萨罗的顶部找到他们。
tasks.objective_text_en: You have been ordered to slay Vile Priestess Hexx and 5 Vilebranch Aman'zasi Guards. See Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands once this task is complete.

tasks.name: 职位空缺：恶齿村卫兵队长
tasks.name_en: Job Opening: Guard Captain of Revantusk Village
tasks.objective_text_zh: 你必须消灭5个邪枝狂战士、3个邪枝暗影猎手、3个邪枝饮血者和3个邪枝噬魂者。 /  / 完成任务之后向辛特兰恶齿村的断齿族长复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: You have been tasked with the decimation of 5 Vilebranch Berserkers, 3 Vilebranch Shadow Hunters, 3 Vilebranch Blood Drinkers, and 2 Vilebranch Soul Eaters.

tasks.name: 邪枝窃贼
tasks.objective_text_zh: 辛特兰恶齿村的铁匠斯拉提要你去找到斯拉提的工具。完成任务之后就回到他那里去。 /  / 你记得铁匠斯拉提说过，你可以在辛特兰东北部的某个邪枝巨魔神庙中找到它，要不然就是在隐匿石那边。
tasks.objective_text_en: Smith Slagtree at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Slagtree's Lost Tools. Return to him once this task is complete.

tasks.name: 找到OOX-09/HL！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把定位器带到奥格索普的母体机器人那里去。 /  / 奥格索普的母体机器人位于辛特兰的河水源头，就在隐匿石的附近。
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot at the head of the river in the Hinterlands, near Skulk Rock.

tasks.name: Questie:3441
tasks.objective_text_en: Listen as Kalaran Windblade tells his story.

tasks.name: 无瑕之焰
tasks.objective_text_zh: 收集4份烈焰之心和4份傀儡之油，然后把这些东西交给威拉罗克·温布雷。
tasks.objective_text_en: Collect 4 Hearts of Flame and 4 globes of Golem Oil and return the items to Kalaran Windblade.

tasks.name: 铸造火炬杆
tasks.objective_text_zh: 给威拉罗克·温布雷带去8把瑟银匕首。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring 8 Thorium Plated Daggers to Kalaran Windblade.

tasks.name: 烈焰之盒
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到一个拉格纳罗斯符记，把它交给威拉罗克·温布雷。
tasks.objective_text_en: Find and return a Symbol of Ragnaros to Kalaran Windblade.

tasks.name: Questie:3453
tasks.objective_text_en: Wait for Kalaran Windblade to complete the Torch of Retribution.

tasks.name: 惩戒火炬
tasks.objective_text_zh: 拿起惩戒火炬。
tasks.objective_text_en: Take the Torch of Retribution.

tasks.name: 侍卫玛特拉克
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与侍卫玛特拉克谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Squire Maltrake.

tasks.name: 烧掉它们！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用惩戒火炬点燃北部、南部、东部和西部的哨塔。
tasks.objective_text_en: Set the North, South, East, and West Sentry Towers on fire by using the Torch of Retribution inside each of the buildings.

tasks.name: 悬赏：工头玛托留斯
tasks.objective_text_zh: 那个叫做工头玛托留斯的黑铁矮人叛徒就藏在大熔炉的熔渣之池深处。 /  / 杀死工头玛托留斯，将他的徽记交给灼热峡谷的侦查队长洛洛尔以换取你的奖励。
tasks.objective_text_en: Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, in the Searing Gorge, you will find the traitorous Dark Iron dwarf named Overseer Maltorius.

tasks.name: 绝密配方！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在大熔炉的熔渣之池中的某个地方，你可以找到工头玛托留斯偷走的秘密设计图：炽热助熔剂。找到这些设计图，把它们还给灼热峡谷的大铁匠博恩奈特。
tasks.objective_text_en: Somewhere in the Slag Pit of the Cauldron you will find the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux that Overseer Maltorius stole. Find those plans and return them to Master Smith Burninate in the Searing Gorge.

tasks.name: 该死的手指头！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 汉瑟尔·重拳让你杀掉20个重型作战傀儡。 /  / 重型作战傀儡就在灼热峡谷的大熔炉附近。当你杀死足够多的傀儡后，就回去找汉瑟尔·重拳。
tasks.objective_text_en: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Heavy War Golems.

tasks.name: 熔岩蜘蛛的威胁！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 汉瑟尔·重拳要你杀死灼热峡谷中的20只巨型熔岩蜘蛛。你可以在灼热峡谷的高地和熔岩池里找到巨型熔岩蜘蛛。 /  / 当你杀死足够的巨型熔岩蜘蛛之后，回到汉瑟尔·重拳那里复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Greater Lava Spiders in the Searing Gorge. You can find Greater Lava Spiders in the plateaus and lava pools of the Searing Gorge.

tasks.name: 熏火龙
tasks.name_en: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It
tasks.objective_text_zh: 汉瑟尔·重拳让你去杀掉20个熏火龙。 /  / 熏火龙侵占了熔渣之池中的那些岩浆池。熔渣之池就在灼热峡谷的大熔炉中。 /  / 当你杀死足够数量的熏火龙后，就回去找汉瑟尔·重拳。
tasks.objective_text_en: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Incendosaurs.

tasks.name: 工作机会：肃清竞争对手
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死15个黑铁工头和15个黑铁奴隶贩子。完成任务之后就回去找监工斯克兰格。
tasks.objective_text_en: Slay 15 Dark Iron Taskmasters and 15 Dark Iron Slavers. Return to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge once you have accomplished this task.

tasks.name: 自由的钥匙
tasks.objective_text_zh: 搜寻灼热峡谷并找到一个可以插入这把格里塞特厕所钥匙的锁眼。
tasks.objective_text_en: Search Searing Gorge and find a use for the Grimesilt Outhouse Key you have found.

tasks.name: 让他们失眠！
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在大熔炉的熔渣之池深处，你可以发现黑铁矮人的休息区。 /  / 到休息区去偷走20只黑铁枕头。当你完成任务后就回到灼热峡谷的艾沃奈斯那里复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, you will find the sleeping quarters of the Dark Iron dwarves.

tasks.name: 看看它的个头！
tasks.name_en: Look at the Size of It!
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将比拉凯琳的枕头交给灼热峡谷的艾沃奈斯。
tasks.objective_text_en: Take Chambermaid Pillaclencher's Pillow to Evonice Sootsmoker in the Searing Gorge.

tasks.name: 被盗：鼓风机和望远镜
tasks.name_en: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到冶炼鼓风机和侦查员的望远镜，把它们还给灼热峡谷的监工斯克兰格。 /  / 你所知道的关于这些物品的惟一信息是：它们肯定是被黑铁矮人偷走的。冶炼鼓风机是铁匠用的锻造工具，侦查员的望远镜是侦查员所需的侦查工具。
tasks.objective_text_en: Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge.

blocks.block: 西瘟疫四锅、安多哈尔与未竟事业

tasks.name: 战斗的号角：瘟疫之地！
tasks.name_en: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
tasks.objective_text_en: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

tasks.name: Questie:5096
tasks.objective_text_en: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent.

tasks.name: 标记哨塔
tasks.objective_text_zh: 使用信号火炬为安多哈尔城中的四座哨塔做上标记，你必须站在哨塔门口才能成功地进行标记。 /  / 在做完了标记之后，将信号火炬还给西瘟疫之地亡灵壁垒的高级执行官德灵顿。
tasks.objective_text_en: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.

tasks.name: 瘟疫之锅
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

tasks.name: 目标：费尔斯通农场
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到西瘟疫之地的费尔斯通农场去，找到并击败那里的护锅者，用它的钥匙打开瘟疫之锅。你必须随身携带费尔斯通农场的空瓶来采集瘟疫之锅中的毒药样本。
tasks.objective_text_en: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

tasks.name: 返回亡灵壁垒
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把费尔斯通农场的样本瓶交给西瘟疫之地亡灵壁垒的暗影牧师范蒂丝。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

tasks.name: 目标：达尔松之泪
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到西瘟疫之地的达尔松之泪去，找到并击败那里的护锅者，用它的钥匙打开瘟疫之锅。你必须随身携带达尔松之泪的空瓶来采集瘟疫之锅中的毒药样本。
tasks.objective_text_en: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

tasks.name: 返回亡灵壁垒
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把装满的达尔松眼泪之瓶交给西瘟疫之地亡灵壁垒的暗影牧师范蒂丝。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

tasks.name: 目标：嚎哭鬼屋
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到西瘟疫之地的嚎哭鬼屋去，找到并击败那里的护锅者，用它的钥匙打开瘟疫之锅。你必须随身携带嚎哭鬼屋的空瓶来采集瘟疫之锅中的毒药样本。
tasks.objective_text_en: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

tasks.name: 返回亡灵壁垒
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把嚎哭鬼屋的样本瓶交给西瘟疫之地亡灵壁垒的暗影牧师范蒂丝。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

tasks.name: 目标：盖罗恩农场
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到西瘟疫之地的盖罗恩农场去，找到并击败那里的护锅者，用它的钥匙打开瘟疫之锅。你必须随身携带盖罗恩农场的空瓶来采集瘟疫之锅中的毒药样本。
tasks.objective_text_en: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

tasks.name: 返回亡灵壁垒
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把盖罗恩农场的样本瓶交给西瘟疫之地亡灵壁垒的暗影牧师范蒂丝。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

tasks.name: 时间问题
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在安多哈尔的一处仓库附近使用时光置换器，使时光寄生虫现身。 /  / 杀掉10只时光寄生虫，然后将时光置换器还给西瘟疫之地安多哈尔旅店的克罗米。
tasks.objective_text_en: Use the Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal's silos and uncover Temporal Parasites.

tasks.name: 迟到总比不到好
tasks.objective_text_zh: 这个女人的幽灵告诉你她要送出一只包裹。她说那只包裹就在她的马旁边。至于马在哪里或者包裹要送到哪里去，她却根本没有说。
tasks.objective_text_en: The ramblings of the ghostly woman indicated that she needed a package delivered. She claimed that it was where her horse was. As to where the horse is or where the package was to be delivered - the ghost remains incomprehensible.

tasks.name: 未竟的事业
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死2个血色医护员、2个血色猎人、2个血色魔法师和2个血色骑士，然后回到西瘟疫之地的科尔斯塔·迪普沙东那儿。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill 2 Scarlet Medics, 2 Scarlet Hunters, 2 Scarlet Magi and 2 Scarlet Knights before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

tasks.name: 未完的任务
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉猎人莱德雷和骑士杜尔根，然后向西瘟疫之地的科尔斯塔·迪普沙东复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

tasks.name: Questie:6025
tasks.objective_text_en: Enter Hearthglen and find a high vantage point from which you can see the town and gauge the Scarlet Crusade's forces, then return to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

tasks.name: 大自然的苦楚
tasks.objective_text_zh: 消灭8只生病的狼，然后去找西瘟疫之地嚎哭鬼屋的穆格雷斯·深水。
tasks.objective_text_en: Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

tasks.name: 大自然的苦楚
tasks.objective_text_zh: 消灭8只生病的灰熊，然后去找西瘟疫之地嚎哭鬼屋的穆格雷斯·深水。
tasks.objective_text_en: Destroy 8 Diseased Grizzlies, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

tasks.name: 小帕米拉
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在达隆郡找到帕米拉·雷德帕斯。
tasks.objective_text_en: Find Pamela Redpath in Darrowshire.

tasks.name: 找回时间
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在安多哈尔城中四处散落的保险箱里找到5只安多哈尔怀表，然后把它们交给西瘟疫之地安多哈尔旅店里的克罗米。
tasks.objective_text_en: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city. Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

blocks.block: 帕米拉历史链与东瘟最短收尾

tasks.name: 帕米拉的洋娃娃
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到帕米拉的洋娃娃。
tasks.objective_text_en: Find Pamela's doll.

tasks.name: 玛莱恩姑妈
tasks.objective_text_zh: 与安多哈尔废墟南边的玛莱恩谈一谈。
tasks.objective_text_en: Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.

tasks.name: 古怪的历史学家
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Joseph's Wedding Ring to Chromie.

tasks.name: 达隆郡的历史
tasks.objective_text_zh: 把《达隆郡的历史》交给安多哈尔的克罗米。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.

tasks.name: 卡林·雷德帕斯
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将《达隆镇全史》交给东瘟疫之地的卡林·雷德帕斯。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

tasks.name: 卡林叔叔
tasks.objective_text_zh: 找到卡林·雷德帕斯。
tasks.objective_text_en: Find Carlin Redpath.

tasks.name: 达隆郡的保卫者
tasks.objective_text_zh: 释放15个达隆郡居民的灵魂，然后返回卡林·雷德帕斯身边。
tasks.objective_text_en: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.

tasks.name: 血染的天空
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀死30只瘟疫蝙蝠，然后向提里奥·弗丁复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.

tasks.name: 讨厌的蝙蝠
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉20只毒性天灾蝙蝠和10只巨型天灾蝙蝠，然后回到纳萨诺斯·凋零者那里。
tasks.objective_text_en: Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.

tasks.name: 流亡者塞达尔
tasks.objective_text_zh: 将塞达尔的徽记交给圣光之愿礼拜堂的护理者奥林。
tasks.objective_text_en: Bring Zaeldarr's Head to Caretaker Alen at Light's Hope Chapel.

tasks.name: 哈米亚的请求
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀了渗透者哈米亚，用他的钥匙开启墓室后的一堆泥土。
tasks.objective_text_en: Kill Infiltrator Hameya. Use his key on the Mound of Dirt behind the Undercroft.

tasks.name: 游侠之王的命令
tasks.objective_text_zh: 到东瘟疫之地的北方边界去找回奎尔萨拉斯名册，这件物品在奎尔林斯小屋的某处。 /  / 另外你还必须杀掉8个游侠、8个巡路者和8个护林者。
tasks.objective_text_en: Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge.

tasks.name: 奥古斯图斯的收据册
tasks.objective_text_zh: 在恐惧谷的旅店中取得奥古斯图斯的收据册。
tasks.objective_text_en: Get Augustus' Receipt Book from the inn in Terrordale.

tasks.name: 恶魔之犬
tasks.objective_text_zh: 杀掉20条瘟疫幼犬、5条瘟疫犬和5条狂怒的瘟疫犬。任务完成之后向提里奥·弗丁复命。
tasks.objective_text_en: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.
